correctness.rationale: For the two differences, the eight ballots yield the stated centered four-vector with covariance (1/8)[[2,0,1,0],[0,2,0,1],[1,0,2,0],[0,1,0,2]]. The support contains zero and signed basis vectors; hence both the irrational integer marginal and the coprime rational projections have unit full-lattice span. Partial Fourier inversion on the pinned integer coordinates and scaling by sqrt(n) give the Gaussian Schur complement on the unpinned coordinates, nondegenerate even at the rational endpoints. Thus asymptotically half of the pair equalities beat the third committee. Pair-equality masses are 2/sqrt(2 pi (a^2+b^2)n) and 2/(pi n), while triple equalities are O(n^-1) and O(n^-2), respectively. The disjoint exactly-two-plus-triple decomposition gives both constants. A fresh exact replay (python3 /workspace/replay_thiele.py) enumerated ordered profiles through n=4 with exact quadratic-irrational comparisons and recovered 1147/4096 and 1075/4096. The frozen checker uses tolerances in some comparisons; neither it nor the replay establishes the infinite limits.
